title: Invisible Hand — IKEA
desc: An independent campaign concept about human craft in the age of AI.
lead: I explored human craft in an independent IKEA campaign concept, using hands, shadows and close-up workshop imagery.
body: I put the maker’s hands at the centre of the campaign, drawing attention to the care behind everyday objects. This was an independent concept, not commissioned by IKEA.
detail: Dramatic light and close-up craft imagery carry the idea through posters and film. Blue-and-yellow illustrations translate gestures such as measuring, sanding and assembling into a supporting graphic system.
captions: Independent concept brief — not commissioned by IKEA
contribution: Developed the campaign idea and visual direction.
Created poster concepts, a supporting illustration system and social applications.
context: Independent concept campaign · not commissioned by IKEA
summary: I explored human craft in an independent IKEA campaign concept, using hands, shadows and close-up workshop imagery.
